title: Multivariable chain rule and held-fixed variables
section: Partial Derivatives ▷ The Chain Rule for Partial Derivatives
terms: multivariable chain rule; dependent variable; intermediate variable; independent variable; total derivative; cyclic partial derivative identity.

Positive variables satisfy x + y + z = 1. What is (∂x/∂y) (∂y/∂z) (∂z/∂x) ?
z x y
(A) −1 (B) 0 (C) 1 (D) xyz (E) −xyz

solution.text:
Implicit differentiation gives the three factors −y/x, −z/y, and −x/z. Their product is −1.
Positivity ensures that none of the denominators is zero.
